# ghost/birdipedia

Filter and read Birdipedia’s offline public bird taxonomy catalog without external links or location

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/birdipedia
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/birdipedia open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/birdipedia filter_birds --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/birdipedia read_results --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/birdipedia clear_filter --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/birdipedia scroll_results --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the offline Birdipedia catalog
- `filter_birds`: Filter public bird names without opening external species pages
- `read_results`: Read the first two fully exposed common and scientific bird names
- `clear_filter`: Clear the temporary bird name filter
- `scroll_results`: Scroll the public bird catalog and read two complete rows
